storeId.description: Durable store that owns this import key and its resource.

state.description: open: send the bound bytes; uploading: a transfer is in flight; ready: resource is published; released: the published managed resource was later released by its caller and admits no new reference, a new attachment needs a new key; cancelled: finished without a resource, a new attempt needs a new key.

uploadId.description: Upload that receives this import's bytes.

sha256.description: Exact digest of the bytes: "sha256:" and 64 lowercase hex digits.

content.description: Exact bytes a keyed import owns, bound by its first accepted declaration.

purpose.description: Immutable model-operation purpose; absent means a legacy or ordinary attachment.

lifetime.description: managed: its caller may later release the ID (POST /v2/resources/:id/release), after which no new reference is admitted while already accepted work keeps the bytes. Absent: indefinite reuse.

kind.description: Kind of attached resource: image input or generic file bytes.

sha256.description: Content hash in algo:hex form, e.g. "sha256:abcd...".

resource.description: The immutable resource, present exactly when state is ready or released.

releasedAt.description: The first release of the resource, present exactly when state is released.

ControlUploadImport.description: Current state of one keyed import, identical for its first call and every replay.
